title: Swords in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
description: Ace to Five of Swords in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for each card, how they form a story of thought and strain, and how to use them in a spread.

scenes.headline: Swords in tarot: Ace to Five meanings
scenes.caption: The Ace to Five of Swords run from clear thinking into strain, rest and conflict. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.
scenes.vo: The Ace to Five of Swords run from clear thinking into strain, rest and conflict. Each card has an upright and a reversed meaning.

scenes.headline: Ace of Swords
scenes.caption: Clarity, truth, a breakthrough in thinking. A hand from a cloud holds an upright sword topped with a crown and wreath.
scenes.vo: Ace of Swords. Clarity, truth, a breakthrough in thinking. A hand from a cloud holds an upright sword topped with a crown and wreath.

scenes.headline: Two of Swords
scenes.caption: Stalemate, difficult choice, avoidance. A blindfolded figure sits with two swords crossed over the chest, in front of a calm sea.
scenes.vo: Two of Swords. Stalemate, difficult choice, avoidance. A blindfolded figure sits with two swords crossed over the chest, in front of a calm sea.

scenes.headline: Three of Swords
scenes.caption: Heartache, sorrow, honest pain. Three swords pierce a heart against a rainy sky.
scenes.vo: Three of Swords. Heartache, sorrow, honest pain. Three swords pierce a heart against a rainy sky.
